summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited reporting the results of voting for directors at its April 16, 2026 Annual Shareholders Meeting. All eleven director nominees were elected with strong majority support. The filing is a standard disclosure of annual meeting outcomes and contains no elements of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or management change. It is purely a report of proxy voting results with no transactional or event-driven content.
